description:
Location: Romania (remote or hybrid)

Contract: Full time & Indefinite

Language(s): English


Serrala is the global leader in finance process automation. For over 40 years, we have been advancing the office of the CFO with our award-winning suite of finance automation applications.

Our solutions streamline all working capital-related processes, including Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Cash Flow Management, and Treasury, across both cloud and SAP environments.

Our 10+ hubs across Europe, North America, and India support over 2,800 clients worldwide, reflecting the trust we've built with a diverse global community.

Join us as we lead the future of finance automation!


About The Role

As a Full‑Stack SAP Developer (ABAP & Fiori/UI5) , you will design, develop, and deliver scalable business applications on SAP while following clean‑core principles. You will collaborate closely with the Product Owner, contribute to technical design decisions, and ensure high‑quality, production‑ready code within an Agile environment.


Main Responsibilities

  • Analyze requirements, design solutions with the Product Owner, and identify dependencies.
  • Lead and contribute to the technical design process, including documentation, impact analysis, and proof‑of‑concept creation.
  • Break down user stories, estimate and plan implementation, write clean and efficient code, maintain documentation, and ensure production readiness.
  • Actively participate in Agile ceremonies and support continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate closely within the team, contribute to cross‑organizational initiatives, and mentor junior colleagues.


Requirements — What Makes a Candidate Excel

  • SAPUI5 Freestyle and Fiori Elements expertise.
  • Knowledge of SAP Clean Core principles.
  • Proven experience in designing and developing business applications.
  • Experience delivering ABAP Cloud applications.
  • Strong hands‑on expertise with SAP ABAP RAP (RESTful Application Programming Model).
  • Skilled in defining and implementing managed and unmanaged behaviors.
  • Proficient in CDS views, business objects, and Core Data Services data modeling.
  • Fluent English; German is a plus.
  • Experience working in Agile environments is an advantage.


Skills, Know‑How & Experience

  • Experience building custom SAP Fiori applications from scratch.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
  • ABAP OO, OData, REST.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Effective communicator and strong team player.


Soft & Interpersonal Skills

  • Team‑oriented mindset.
  • Strong communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Proactive approach to problem‑solving.


Development Opportunities

  • Exposure to modern SAP technologies and cloud solutions.
  • Opportunity to contribute to core product development in an international environment.


Why you’ll love it here

Step into a dynamic, agile workplace where continuous learning is championed by leadership, and innovation in finance automation is fuelled by cutting-edge tech, AI integration, and strategic SAP transformation. We partner with the best to stay ahead - so you can too.

At our core, we're Reliable, Passionate, Empowering, and Enterprising - committed to lasting customer and employee relationships, bold innovation, and your growth every step of the way.
